```{julia}
using DataFrames
using CairoMakie

function grid_from_df(df::DataFrame; x=:interaction_rate, y=:dead_time, z=:exactly_ratio_mean)
    xs = sort(unique(df[!, x]))
    ys = sort(unique(df[!, y]))
    x_to_i = Dict(v => i for (i,v) in enumerate(xs))
    y_to_j = Dict(v => j for (j,v) in enumerate(ys))

    Z = fill(NaN, length(xs), length(ys))
    for r in eachrow(df)
        Z[x_to_i[r[x]], y_to_j[r[y]]] = r[z]
    end
    return xs, ys, Z
end

function plot_coverage_heatmap_loglog_flipped(df::DataFrame;
    alpha=:interaction_rate,
    tau=:dead_time,
    z=:exactly_ratio_mean,
    θ::Union{Nothing,Float64}=0.9,
    labelsize=34,
    ticksize=30
)

    df2 = filter(r -> r[alpha] > 0 && r[tau] > 0 && !ismissing(r[z]), df)

    # Build grid in original orientation
    alphas, taus, Z = grid_from_df(df2; x=alpha, y=tau, z=z)
    #Z[22,19] = 0.0 # patch missing value for 5x5 heatmap

    fig = Figure(size=(1000, 720))
    ax = Axis(fig[1,1];
        xscale=log10,
        yscale=log10,
        xlabel="Refractory time, τ",
        ylabel="Suppression-rate prefactor, α",
        #xlabel = "Suppression-strength product ατ",
        #ylabel = "Interaction asymmetry (η)",
        xlabelsize=labelsize,
        ylabelsize=labelsize,
        xticklabelsize=ticksize,
        yticklabelsize=ticksize,
        title=""
    )

    # Flip axes: x = taus, y = alphas
    hm = heatmap!(ax, taus, alphas, Z')   # NOTE THE TRANSPOSE Z'

    if θ !== nothing
        contour!(ax, taus, alphas, Z'; levels=[θ], linewidth=3)
    end

    Colorbar(fig[1,2], hm;
        label="Coverage fraction, C_{≥θ}(T)/M (θ=0.9)",
        labelsize=labelsize,
        ticklabelsize=ticksize
    )

    fig
end
```

```{julia}
using DataFrames
using CairoMakie

function grid_from_df(df::DataFrame; x=:interaction_rate, y=:dead_time, z=:exactly_ratio_mean)
    xs = sort(unique(df[!, x]))
    ys = sort(unique(df[!, y]))
    x_to_i = Dict(v => i for (i,v) in enumerate(xs))
    y_to_j = Dict(v => j for (j,v) in enumerate(ys))

    Z = fill(NaN, length(xs), length(ys))
    for r in eachrow(df)
        Z[x_to_i[r[x]], y_to_j[r[y]]] = r[z]
    end
    return xs, ys, Z
end

function plot_heatmap_loglog(df::DataFrame; x=:interaction_rate, y=:dead_time, z=:exactly_ratio_mean,
                             title="Mean coverage", outfile=nothing)
    df2 = filter(r -> r[x] > 0 && r[y] > 0 && !ismissing(r[z]), df)

    xs, ys, Z = grid_from_df(df2; x=x, y=y, z=z)

    labelsize = 28
    ticklabelsize = 24

    fig = Figure(size=(900,700))

    ax = Axis(fig[1,1];
        xscale=log10, yscale=log10,
        #xlabel="Suppression-rate prefactor α",
        #ylabel="Refractory time τ",
        #xlabel = L"\alpha \;\;(\mathrm{interaction\ rate})",
        #ylabel = L"\tau \;\;(\mathrm{dead\ time})",
        xlabel = L"\text{Suppression-rate prefactor} \;\; \alpha",
        xlabelsize=labelsize, ylabelsize=labelsize,
        xticklabelsize=ticklabelsize, yticklabelsize=ticklabelsize,
        title="", titlesize=labelsize,
    )

    hm = heatmap!(ax, xs, ys, Z)  # colormap default is fine
    cb = Colorbar(fig[1,2], hm; label="Coverage  C_{≥θ}(T)/M", labelsize=labelsize, ticklabelsize=ticklabelsize)

    if outfile !== nothing
        save(outfile, fig)
    end
    return fig
end

```
